title: BECE Business Studies: Office Practice - Business Studies - Office Documents
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Written or printed materials that provide official information, instructions, or evidence of business transactions in an organization are referred to as
questions.explain: **Office documents** are official records (such as letters, memos, invoices, and receipts) used to communicate, provide information, and act as evidence of business activities.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In the context of business trading, office documents are broadly classified into two main types based on transactions. These are
questions.explain: To facilitate trade, office transaction records are typically categorized into **Sales documents** (prepared by the seller) and **Purchase documents** (prepared by the buyer).
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The very first purchase document initiated by a prospective buyer to find out about the availability and prices of goods from a supplier is an
questions.explain: A letter of **enquiry** is the initial document sent by a buyer asking for details like price, availability, and terms of sale for specific goods.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a seller receives an enquiry, the appropriate sales document sent in reply to state the current prices and terms of sale is the
questions.explain: A **quotation** is a sales document sent in response to an enquiry, detailing the exact prices, discounts, and terms under which the seller is willing to supply the goods.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following purchase documents is an official request sent by a buyer committing to buy specific quantities of goods at agreed prices?
questions.explain: An **order**, often called a Local Purchase Order (LPO), is the official purchase document prepared by the buyer authorizing the seller to supply specific goods.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When preparing a Local Purchase Order (LPO), it is essential to ensure that the document includes the
options: description and quantity of the items needed
personal home addresses of the buyer's staff
questions.explain: During the preparation of an order (LPO), crucial details must include the date, the **description, quantity of the items needed**, and the authorized signature of the buyer.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A polite request demanding payment in advance before goods are dispatched to a new customer is usually made by sending a
questions.explain: A **proforma invoice** looks like a regular invoice but is often used as a polite demand for payment *before* goods are supplied, especially for new customers.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A sales document prepared by the seller to demand payment from a buyer for goods supplied on credit is the
questions.explain: An **invoice** is the primary commercial bill drawn up by the seller and sent to the buyer, listing goods supplied and the total amount owed.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: If a customer is mistakenly overcharged on an invoice, or returns damaged goods, the seller will issue which document to reduce the customer's debt?
questions.explain: A **credit note** (usually printed in red) is a sales document sent by a seller to a buyer to reduce the amount the buyer owes, due to returns or overcharges.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A seller discovers that an arithmetic error caused a buyer to be undercharged by ₦5,000 on their last order. To correct this, the seller should send a
questions.explain: A **debit note** is issued by the seller to correct an undercharge, effectively informing the buyer that their debt has been increased by the stated amount.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A summary document sent periodically (usually at the end of the month) by a seller to a buyer, showing all purchases, payments, and the final outstanding balance is the
questions.explain: The **statement of account** acts as a reminder and summary. It lists all the invoices, payments, and credit notes for a period, showing the net amount the buyer still owes.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The document that serves as final proof that a business transaction has been concluded because payment has been made is the
questions.explain: A **receipt** is the official written acknowledgment from the seller that money has been received from the buyer, concluding the payment aspect of the trade.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following options shows the correct chronological flow of documents in a business transaction?
questions.explain: The standard sequence is: The buyer asks about price (**Enquiry**), the seller replies with prices (**Quotation**), the buyer requests goods (**Order**), the seller supplies and demands payment (**Invoice**), and upon payment, issues a confirmation (**Receipt**).
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Purchase documents are primarily used by a business organization to
options: increase the selling price of their goods randomly
track procurement, prevent fraud, and serve as evidence of buying
hide profits from government tax collectors
calculate the exact number of visitors in the reception
questions.explain: The preparation and keeping of purchase documents (like copies of LPOs and received invoices) are crucial to **track procurement, prevent fraud, and serve as evidence** of what the business has bought.
questions.subject: Business Studies
